groupPrefix.description: The prefix the Kubernetes API server gives the groups of the users its tokens authenticate (the groups prefix of its token authenticator: its command-line flag, or the claimMappings of its structured authentication configuration): the RoleBindings of a project's groups name each group with it, k8s:okdp-project-demo for k8s:. Argo CD reads the groups claim as it is, without it. Absent: "", the groups as the tokens give them.

network.description: The network policy of the projects' namespaces. Another key is refused: a misspelt one would leave the namespaces open.

policy.description: true: the targets write, in each project's namespace but the platform's own (policy.privileged, a setting of the security set), a NetworkPolicy that denies every ingress to its pods but from the namespace itself, from ingressNamespaces and from the namespaces whose claims its instances provide; egress left open. false or absent: none, the namespaces open (the targets do not know the cluster's ingress controller, nor whether its network plugin enforces policies).

ingressNamespaces.description: With policy: the namespaces whose pods reach every project's pods: the ingress controller's, a monitoring's. Absent: none, a project's services reached by its own namespace and its claimers only.

controlPlane.description: The optional control plane (okdp-control-plane-server). Absent: the platform has none, and the targets bind no identity of it. Another key is refused.

serviceAccount.description: The control plane's identity, its ServiceAccount: the targets bind it, in each project's namespace, privileged or not, to the Role okdp-control-plane, what it needs there and nothing more; its ClusterRole keeps namespaces get and create.

projectApiGroups.description: API groups added to the Role a project's releases are installed with in its namespace (the Flux target's): the groups of the custom resources a project's charts deploy beside those the target lists. RBAC has no negation: the Role lists its groups, and the groups of the deployer engines (the security set's deployerApiGroups), or *, are never added, whatever this list says. A chart's Role of a group that is not added is refused by the API server (escalation).
